name: rarecloud
description: Skills that turn a coding agent into a DevOps engineer: set up and secure Linux servers, deploy to a server or Kubernetes on any provider, and fix what breaks. Includes RareCloud's own skill and MCP server, which need a RareCloud account and API token; the skills work without them.

settings.name: RareCloud API token
settings.description: A RareCloud API token, created at https://console.rarecloud.io/account/api. Only the MCP tools need it.
